global_rules: Every mapped dimension has one primary authority.
Specialists diagnose and produce evidence; they do not rewrite.
Packet 012 prose craft and Packet 013 reader experience remain separate authorities and are not absorbed into the five granular specialists.
Reader predictions are reception evidence, never text-side defect truth and never human observations.
Correlated findings are not independent votes.
Cross-authority contradictions route to review rather than averaging or vote-counting.
No specialist can override canon, protected language, authorial intent, POV knowledge boundaries or explicit user constraints.
Originality cannot override coherence or preservation.
Theme interpretation cannot become author intent or external factual/theological truth.
Pacing structure remains distinct from predicted reader momentum/tension.
LEVEL_0_NO_CHANGE remains available for every material revision decision.
Named-author similarity is never a target.
